title: Scripts + versions without -A
body: Prefer nmap -sC -sV -p- over blind -A. Faster feedback, less noise, same intel on most labs.

title: Host discovery first
body: On a flat lab net: nmap -sn 10.10.0.0/24 then target live hosts. Skip -Pn until you know ICMP is blocked.

title: Match and replace
body: Proxy → Match and replace: auto-fix a header or cookie across Repeater/Intruder. Stop hand-editing the same byte 40 times.

title: Logger++ / Logger tab
body: Keep a full history of proxied traffic. When a bug reproduces once, your scrollback is the writeup backbone.

title: HTTP POSTs only
body: Display filter: http.request.method == "POST". Combine with ip.addr== your lab target.

title: Follow the stream
body: Right-click → Follow → TCP/HTTP Stream. Rebuild the conversation instead of squinting at frames.

title: search + info before exploit
body: search type:exploit apache then info / show options. Set RHOSTS, check required options, then run. Labs love patience.

title: Workspaces keep you honest
body: workspace -a lab-oslo isolates hosts/loot per engagement. Don't mix client A with Friday CTF notes.

title: Own AP / own handshake
body: Capture and crack only networks you own or are contracted to test. Lab kit + isolated AP = education. Neighbour's SSID = crime.

title: airmon-ng check kill
body: Kill NetworkManager interference before monitor mode. Remember to restart networking after the lab session.

title: Throttle or get banned
body: Use -t 4 and respect lockouts. Against production without written scope: don't. Against your lab: still be nice to the logs.

title: Level/risk deliberately
body: Start low: default level/risk, then climb. Add --tamper only when a WAF actually blocks. Always --batch in labs you own.

title: Dump with intent
body: --tables / --columns before --dump. Know what you're extracting and why it is in scope.

title: Format detection
body: john --list=formats | rg -i sha then --format= explicitly. Wrong format = silent sadness.

title: Mode numbers matter
body: Example: -m 1000 NTLM, -m 1800 sha512crypt. Check the example hashes wiki before burning GPU time.

title: Filter smart
body: ffuf -u URL/FUZZ -w wordlist -mc 200,204,301,302,403 -fs <size> to drop boring catch-all responses.
